items.prompt: Which statement best matches the Amateur Radio Service purpose under 47 CFR Part 97 as summarized for makers?
choices: A commercial messaging service for businesses
A licensed non-commercial service for self-training, intercommunication and technical investigation
An unlicensed ISM band with no identification rules
A satellite-only service with no ground stations
items.answer: A licensed non-commercial service for self-training, intercommunication and technical investigation

items.prompt: In the US, who typically administers amateur licence examinations?
choices: Any electronics store clerk
Volunteer Examiners under the FCC Volunteer Examiner system
Only ITU staff in Geneva
Only the manufacturer of your handheld
items.answer: Volunteer Examiners under the FCC Volunteer Examiner system

items.prompt: Which exam element is the common entry path for a US Technician class licence?
choices: Element 2
Element 9
HAREC Morse sending only
ERC/REC 70-03 Annex scoring

items.prompt: Why does Part 97 require station identification?
choices: So advertisers can bill airtime
So administrations and other operators can identify who is transmitting
Only when using LoRaWAN
Only on 433 MHz SRD
items.answer: So administrations and other operators can identify who is transmitting

items.prompt: Before transmitting on an amateur frequency, a good operating habit is to:
choices: Key up immediately at maximum power
Listen first to avoid interfering with an ongoing contact
Ignore band plans if the waterfall looks empty
Use someone else's callsign for practice
items.answer: Listen first to avoid interfering with an ongoing contact

items.prompt: A station under your control must be operated:
choices: Without any regard for frequency allocations
In accordance with the rules that apply to your licence class and the privileges you are using
Only with encrypted hobby chat on HF
Only when the module datasheet allows higher power than the rules
items.answer: In accordance with the rules that apply to your licence class and the privileges you are using

items.prompt: Which practice belongs in a safe first-QSO checklist?
choices: Disable all identification to save airtime
Confirm antenna connected, frequency allowed for your privileges, and listen before keying
Borrow a callsign from a forum post
Transmit a false distress call as a test
items.answer: Confirm antenna connected, frequency allowed for your privileges, and listen before keying

items.prompt: A 433 MHz LoRa node under an EU SRD entry and a US amateur VHF handheld are:
choices: The same legal path everywhere
Different legal paths with different power, ID and authorization rules
Both always illegal
Both free of any national rules
items.answer: Different legal paths with different power, ID and authorization rules
